name: Tile and Slide Framework
definition: An out-of-core framework that scales NeRFs to large scenes (e.g., 10km x 10km) by dividing the region of interest into non-overlapping 3D tiles, each trained with its own NeRF, operating on a single GPU without loading all images or networks simultaneously.
summary: The Tile and Slide Framework scales NeRFs to large scenes on a single GPU using a sliding window of independent tiles and segmented sampling to prevent catastrophic forgetting.
